def HasAlgebraType (B : Type) [CommRing B] [Algebra O B] (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (L : ι → Type) (_ : ∀ i, Field (L i))
    (_ : ∀ i, Algebra (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra O (L i))
    (_ : ∀ i, IsScalarTower O (BaseField O) (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (BaseField O) (L i))
    (_ : (BaseField O ⊗[O] B) ≃ₐ[BaseField O] (∀ i, L i)),
    σ = ∑ i, ({fieldInvariant O (L i)} : FactorType) ∧
      ∀ i, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (L i))

def integralClosureTowerEquiv (O Oδ L : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing Oδ] [Algebra O Oδ]

  have : Algebra.IsIntegral O Oδ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite O Oδ
  exact
  { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, x.2.tower_top⟩
    invFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, isIntegral_trans _ x.2⟩
    left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
    right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
    map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
    commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }

      ∧ factorInvariant O (C (g.coeff 0)⁻¹ * g.reverse) = factorInvariant O g

private def blockDeg : ClosedDirection k → ℕ → ℕ
  | none, r => r
  | some φ, r => φ.val.natDegree * r

private lemma blockDeg_eq_mul (Q : ClosedDirection k) (r : ℕ) :
    blockDeg Q r = directionDegree k Q * r

private noncomputable def blockG (Q : ClosedDirection k) (r : ℕ) : Fin (blockDeg Q r + 1) → k :=
  fun i => (blockPoly Q r).coeff i
private lemma blockG_nu (a : ClosedDirection k) (r : ℕ) : blockG a r (blockNu a r) = 1
private lemma blockG_single (r : ℕ) : blockG (none : ClosedDirection k) r = Pi.single 0 1

private noncomputable def blockPoly : ClosedDirection k → ℕ → Polynomial k
  | none, _ => 1
  | some φ, r => φ.val ^ r

private lemma blockPoly_isCoprime (a b : ClosedDirection k) (ra rb : ℕ) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    IsCoprime (blockPoly a ra) (blockPoly b rb)

private lemma blockPoly_natDegree_le (Q : ClosedDirection k) (r : ℕ) :
    (blockPoly Q r).natDegree ≤ blockDeg Q r

private lemma blockPoly_natDegree_or (a b : ClosedDirection k) (ra rb : ℕ) (hne : a ≠ b) :
    (blockPoly a ra).natDegree = blockDeg a ra ∨ (blockPoly b rb).natDegree = blockDeg b rb

private lemma blockPoly_some_natDegree (φ : AffineDirection k) (r : ℕ) :
    (blockPoly (some φ) r).natDegree = blockDeg (some φ) r

private lemma block_law (hroot : RootCellLaw) (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (a : ClosedDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (τ : FactorType) :
    MeasurableSet (reducedFormCell O (blockDeg a r) (blockNu a r) (blockG a r) ∩
      (if a.isNone = true then infinityBlockEvent O (blockDeg a r) τ else typeEvent O
      (blockDeg a r) τ)) ∧ cellMeasure O (blockDeg a r) (reducedFormCell O (blockDeg a r)
      (blockNu a r) (blockG a r)) (if a.isNone = true then infinityBlockEvent O (blockDeg a r) τ
      else typeEvent O (blockDeg a r) τ) = densityValue (lawCoeff
      (lawDescend (directionDegree _ a) (stateLaw (State.single 1 r))) τ)
      (Nat.card (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O))

    (hr : 0 < r) (τ : FactorType) :
    0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawDescend (directionDegree _ a) (stateLaw (State.single 1 r))) τ).eval
      (Nat.card k)

private theorem coefficientMeasure_inter_eq_mul (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n) ∧ (∀ a : Fin (n+1) → O, primitive O a → ∃! D :

      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n ∧ a ∈ projectiveCell O n

      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) D = n → MeasurableSet

      (divisorVector (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) n D)) = coefficientMeasure O (n+1)

def Allowed (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Prop :=
  0<P.d.val ∧ P.rt.val+P.rx.val+patternWeight P.other=P.d.val ∧
  match s with
  | .single _ c => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.rx.val=0 ∧ (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c)
  | .crossing _ _ c h => P.d.val≤c ∧ P.d.val≤h ∧
      (0<P.rt.val ↔ P.d.val<c) ∧ (0<P.rx.val ↔ P.d.val<h)
abbrev BaseField := FractionRing O

inductive Expr where
  | const (r : ℚ)
  | var
  | add (x y : Expr)
  | mul (x y : Expr)
  | inv (x : Expr)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq
def allSafe (x : Expr) : Prop := ∀ q : ℕ, 2 ≤ q → x.safe q

def eval (q : ℚ) : Expr → ℚ
  | .const r => r
  | .var => q
  | .add x y => eval q x + eval q y
  | .mul x y => eval q x * eval q y
  | .inv x => (eval q x)⁻¹

def fraction : Expr → Polynomial ℚ × Polynomial ℚ
  | .const r => (Polynomial.C r, 1)
  | .var => (Polynomial.X, 1)
  | .add x y => let a := fraction x; let b := fraction y
               (a.1*b.2+b.1*a.2, a.2*b.2)
  | .mul x y => let a := fraction x; let b := fraction y
               (a.1*b.1, a.2*b.2)
  | .inv x => let a := fraction x; (a.2,a.1)
def neg (x : Expr) : Expr := .mul (.const (-1)) x

def pow (x : Expr) : ℕ → Expr
  | 0 => .const 1
  | n+1 => .mul (pow x n) x
def prod (xs : List Expr) : Expr := xs.foldr .mul (.const 1)

def safe (q : ℚ) : Expr → Prop
  | .const _ => True
  | .var => True
  | .add x y => safe q x ∧ safe q y
  | .mul x y => safe q x ∧ safe q y
  | .inv x => safe q x ∧ eval q x ≠ 0
def sub (x y : Expr) : Expr := .add x y.neg

def subst (x : Expr) (y : Expr) : Expr :=
  match x with
  | .const r => .const r
  | .var => y
  | .add a b => .add (subst a y) (subst b y)
  | .mul a b => .mul (subst a y) (subst b y)
  | .inv a => .inv (subst a y)
def sum (xs : List Expr) : Expr := xs.foldr .add (.const 0)
abbrev FactorType := Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)

def HasBinaryType {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  let F := affinePolynomial O a
  F≠0 ∧ F.natDegree≤n ∧ n-F.natDegree≤1 ∧
    ∃ τ, HasPolynomialType O (Polynomial.C F.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * F) τ ∧
      σ=τ+Multiset.replicate (n-F.natDegree) (1,1)

def HasBinaryTypeF {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  let F := affinePolynomial O a
  F≠0 ∧ F.natDegree≤n ∧ n-F.natDegree≤1 ∧
    ∃ τ, HasPolynomialTypeF O (Polynomial.C F.leadingCoeff⁻¹ * F) τ ∧
      σ=τ+Multiset.replicate (n-F.natDegree) (1,1)

def HasPolynomialType (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
    (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧ gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h) ∧
    F=gs.prod ∧ σ=(gs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ))

def HasPolynomialTypeF (F : Polynomial (BaseField O)) (σ : FactorType) : Prop :=
  ∃ gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField O)),
    (∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g) ∧ gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h) ∧
    F=gs.prod ∧ σ=(gs.map (factorInvariant O) : Multiset (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧
    ∀ g ∈ gs, Module.Finite O (integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g))
abbrev Law := List (FactorType × Expr)
def LawSafe (L : Law) : Prop := ∀ z ∈ L, z.2.allSafe
def PadicUnramified : Prop := Irreducible (p : padicIntegers p K)
abbrev Pattern (n : ℕ) := (Fin n × Fin n) → Fin (n+1)
def PrimePower (q : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ p r : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ 0<r ∧ q=p^r

def RegularAt (f : RatFunc ℚ) (q : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ P Q : Polynomial ℚ, Q.eval q ≠ 0 ∧

      algebraMap (Polynomial ℚ) (RatFunc ℚ) Q

def SelfPattern (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Prop :=
  ∃ a c, s = .single a c ∧ children s P = [(1,s)]

inductive State where
  | single (a c : ℕ)
  | crossing (a b c h : ℕ)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Valid : State → Prop
  | .single a c => 0 < a ∧ 0 < c
  | .crossing a b c h => 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < h

def degree : State → ℕ
  | .single a c => a*c
  | .crossing a b c h => a*c+b*h
def rank (s : State) : ℕ := 2*s.degree*s.degree + 2*(s.degree-s.weight) + s.tag

def tag : State → ℕ
  | .single _ _ => 0
  | .crossing _ _ _ _ => 1

def terminal : State → Bool
  | .single _ 1 => true
  | _ => false

def weight : State → ℕ
  | .single a _ => a
  | .crossing a b _ _ => a+b

structure TangentPattern (n : ℕ) where
  d : Fin (n+1)
  rt : Fin (n+1)
  rx : Fin (n+1)
  other : Pattern n
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
def ValidType (σ : FactorType) : Prop := ∀ z ∈ σ, 0 < z.1 ∧ 0 < z.2

def affinePolynomial {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) : Polynomial (BaseField O) :=
  ∑ i : Fin (n+1), Polynomial.C (algebraMap O (BaseField O) (a i)) * Polynomial.X^i.val

noncomputable def allowedPatterns (s : State) : Finset (TangentPattern s.degree) :=
  (Finset.univ).filter (Allowed s)

def availablePoints (offset : ℤ) (δ : ℕ) : Expr :=
  if δ=1 then .add .var (.const offset) else pointCount δ

def children (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : List (ℕ × State) :=
  match s with
  | .single a c =>
    (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing a a P.rt.val (c-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren a P.other
  | .crossing a b c h =>
    (if P.rt.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing (a+b) a P.rt.val (c-P.d.val))]) ++
    (if P.rx.val=0 then [] else [(1,.crossing (a+b) b P.rx.val (h-P.d.val))]) ++
      otherChildren (a+b) P.other
def chooseTwo (d : ℕ) : ℕ := d*(d-1)/2

noncomputable def coefficientMeasure (n : ℕ) : Measure (Fin n → O) :=
  (Measure.addHaar (G := Fin n → O) Set.univ)⁻¹ • Measure.addHaar (G := Fin n → O)
abbrev densityValue (x : Expr) (q : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal ((x.eval q : ℚ) : ℝ)

def divisorCount {n : ℕ} (offset : ℤ) (m : Pattern n) : Expr :=
  Expr.prod ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).toList.map fun i =>
    .mul (falling (availablePoints offset (i.val+1)) (∑ j : Fin n, (m (i,j)).val))
      (.const (1 / (∏ j : Fin n, ((Nat.factorial (m (i,j)).val : ℕ) : ℚ)))))

def divisorProbability (s : State) (d : ℕ) : Expr :=
  match s with
  | .single _ c => .mul (.inv (.pow .var (tri d))) (.pow eminusOne (if d<c then 1 else 0))
  | .crossing _ _ c h =>
    let j := (if d<c then 1 else 0) + (if d<h then 1 else 0)
    .mul (.inv (.pow .var (chooseTwo d)))
      (if j=0 then .inv eminusOne else .pow eminusOne (j-1))
def eminusOne : Expr := .sub .var (.const 1)

noncomputable def factorInvariant (g : Polynomial (BaseField O)) : ℕ × ℕ := by
  classical
  let B := integralClosure O (AdjoinRoot g)
  exact if h : IsLocalRing B then
    letI : IsLocalRing B := h
    ((maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx O, (maximalIdeal B).inertiaDeg O)
  else (0,0)

def falling (x : Expr) (m : ℕ) : Expr :=
  Expr.prod ((List.range m).map fun j => .sub x (.const j))

noncomputable def globalLaw (projective : Bool) (n : ℕ) : Law :=
  lawScale (.inv (if projective then projectiveNormalizer n else .pow .var n))
    ((residuePatterns n).toList.flatMap fun m =>
      lawScale (divisorCount (if projective then 1 else 0) m)

def lawAtom (e f : ℕ) : Law := [({(e,f)}, .const 1)]

def lawCoeff (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) : Expr :=
  Expr.sum (L.map fun z => if z.1=σ then z.2 else .const 0)

def lawDescend (δ : ℕ) (L : Law) : Law :=
  L.map fun z => (scaleType δ z.1, z.2.subst (.pow .var δ))
def lawMul (L M : Law) : Law := L.flatMap fun z => M.map fun w => (z.1+w.1,.mul z.2 w.2)
def lawOne : Law := [(0, .const 1)]
def lawProd (Ls : List Law) : Law := Ls.foldr lawMul lawOne
def lawScale (x : Expr) (L : Law) : Law := L.map fun z => (z.1,.mul x z.2)

noncomputable def monicDensity (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  coefficientMeasure O n {a | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}

noncomputable def monicDensityF (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  coefficientMeasure O n {a | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}
noncomputable def monicExpr (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : Expr := lawCoeff (globalLaw false n) σ
abbrev padicIntegers : Type := ↥(integralClosure ℤ_[p] K)

def patternWeight {n : ℕ} (m : Pattern n) : ℕ :=
  ∑ ij : Fin n × Fin n, (ij.1.val+1)*(ij.2.val+1)*(m ij).val
def primitive {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → O) : Prop := ∃ i, IsUnit (a i)
noncomputable def projectiveExpr (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : Expr := lawCoeff (globalLaw true n) σ

def projectiveNormalizer (n : ℕ) : Expr :=
  Expr.sum ((List.range (n+1)).map fun i => .pow .var i)

noncomputable def residuePatterns (n : ℕ) : Finset (Pattern n) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun m => patternWeight m=n
def returnWeight (c : ℕ) : Expr := .mul .var (.inv (.pow .var (tri c)))
noncomputable def rootLaw (r : ℕ) : Law := if r=0 then lawOne else stateLaw (.single 1 r)
def scaleType (δ : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : FactorType := σ.map fun z => (z.1, δ * z.2)
noncomputable def stateLaw (s : State) : Law := stateLawFuel (s.rank+1) s

noncomputable def stateLawFuel : ℕ → State → Law
  | 0, _ => []
  | k+1, s =>
    match s with
    | .single a 1 => lawAtom a 1
    | _ =>
      let terms := (allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P =>
        if SelfPattern s P then [] else
          lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
            (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z => lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel k z.2)))

      | .single _ c => lawScale (.inv (.sub (.const 1) (returnWeight c))) terms
      | .crossing _ _ _ _ => terms

def stateVolume : State → Expr
  | .single _ c => .inv (.pow .var c)
  | .crossing _ _ c h => .mul eminusOne (.inv (.pow .var (c+h)))

def tangentCount (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Expr :=
  divisorCount (match s with | .single _ _ => 0 | .crossing _ _ _ _ => -1) P.other
def tri (d : ℕ) : ℕ := d*(d+1)/2
def typeDegree (σ : FactorType) : ℕ := (σ.map fun z => z.1 * z.2).sum

theorem actual_finite_cech_coefficient_triangular (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra O R] (t x : R) (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal]
    (hres : Function.Surjective (algebraMap O (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}))) (d n : ℕ) (hn : d - 1 ≤ n)
    (hpres : ∀ j : ℕ, cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) :
    Module.length O
      (CechLevelOutput R t x n ⧸ LinearMap.range (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d n (hpres n)))
      = (chooseTwo d : ℕ∞)

theorem actual_twisted_coker_reduction_bijective (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ j + 1)
    (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hnow : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤
      (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hcomm : (cechOutputReduction R t x j).comp
        (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j + 1) hnext) =
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow).comp (cechInputReduction R t x j)) :
    Function.Bijective (twoTermCokerMap (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext)
      (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow) (cechInputReduction R t x j)
      (cechOutputReduction R t x j) hcomm)

private theorem curveIdealLattice_le_of_le {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    curveIdealLattice R t x beta G k ≤ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j

theorem curve_limit_range_of_stable_level (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t)
    (hregF : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c))
    (f : R)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R t x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j))
    [IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {t,x}) R] (J : ℕ) (hJ : d - 1 ≤ J)
    (σ : R →ₗ[R] CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G)
    (hσ : ∀ r : R, ∃ p : curveThreads R t x beta G, σ r = curveLimitMk R t x beta G p ∧ ∀ j : ℕ,
      p.val j = surfaceToChartPair R t x r)
    (p : curveThreads R t x beta G)
    (hp : ∃ r : R, p.val J - surfaceToChartPair R t x r ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G J) :
    curveLimitMk R t x beta G p ∈ LinearMap.range σ

private theorem exists_surface_approx_of_stable_level {R : Type} [CommRing R] {t x : R}
    {beta : BlowupRestriction R t x} {d : ℕ} (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t)
    (hregF : ∀ j : ℕ, Function.Injective (fun c : BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸
      (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (G.left j)) * c))
    {J : ℕ} (hJ : d - 1 ≤ J) (p : curveThreads R t x beta G)
    (hp : ∃ r : R, p.val J - surfaceToChartPair R t x r ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G J)
    (j : ℕ) : ∃ r : R, p.val j - surfaceToChartPair R t x r ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j

private theorem sum_range_sub_sub_one_eq_chooseTwo (d n : ℕ) (hn : d - 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (d-j-1) : ℕ) = chooseTwo d

private theorem thread_mem_curveSections (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) (j : ℕ) :
    p.val j ∈ curveSections R t x beta G j

private theorem thread_sub_mem (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    p.val j - p.val k ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j

private theorem thread_sub_succ_mem (p : curveThreads R t x beta G) (j : ℕ) :
    p.val j - p.val (j+1) ∈ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j

SurfaceBlowup/Blowup/Charts.lean::Surfac.statement: abbrev AllPoints := D.ι ⊕ (D.ι0 ⊕ D.ιinf)
abbrev BlowupChart (t x : R) := Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {blowupRelation R t x}
abbrev BlowupOverlap (t x : R) := Localization.Away (chartSlope R t x)

structure BlowupRestriction where
  right : BlowupChart R x t →ₐ[R] BlowupOverlap R t x
  slope : right (chartSlope R x t) = IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x)

def CechInputThreads : Type :=
  towerThreads R (fun j => CechLevelInput R t x j) (cechInputReduction R t x)

abbrev CechLevelInput (j : ℕ) :=
  (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ cechInputLattice R t x j

abbrev CechLevelOutput (j : ℕ) :=
  BlowupOverlap R t x ⧸ cechOutputLattice R t x j
abbrev ChartPair := BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t
abbrev CompletedLocalAt := LocalCompletion (Localization.AtPrime P)
def CurveOrderLimit : Type := (curveThreads R t x beta G) ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G

abbrev ExceptionalChartLevel (t x : R) (j : ℕ) :=
  BlowupChart R t x ⧸ exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x j

abbrev ExceptionalOverlapLevel (t x : R) (j : ℕ) :=
  Localization.Away (levelSlope R t x j)

abbrev FiniteContact (e : A) (g : CompletedLocalAt A P) : Prop :=
  ∃ L : ℕ, ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).map
    (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)))^L ≤ finiteLocalCurveIdeal A P e g 1

structure GluedGenerators (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) where
  left : ℕ → BlowupChart R t x
  right : ℕ → BlowupChart R x t
  left_compat : ∀ j : ℕ, left (j+1) - left j ∈ (chartExceptional R t x)^j
  right_compat : ∀ j : ℕ, right (j+1) - right j ∈ (chartExceptional R x t)^j
  overlap : ∀ j : ℕ, algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (left j) -
    (overlapSlope R t x)^d * beta.right (right j) ∈ (Ideal.span {overlapException R t x})^j

def HasTangentDivisor (S : SurfaceData O R) (J : Ideal R) (d : ℕ)
    (D : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : R, ∃ H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
    J = Ideal.span {f} ∧ HasHomogeneousDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) d H D ∧
      f - tangentLift O R S d H ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)^(d+1)
abbrev LocalCompletion := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A

abbrev LocallyTransverse (e : A) (g : CompletedLocalAt A P) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (fun a : CompletedLocalAt A P ⧸ Ideal.span {g} =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (completedPointMap A P e) * a)

structure MatchesDivisor (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : Prop
        where
  common : ∀ i : D.ι, ∃ φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), φ ≠ zeroAffine
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ∧
    D.Q i = (directionPoint R t x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) ∧
    Dv (some φ) = commonMultiplicity D i
  common_surj : ∀ φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), φ ≠ zeroAffine
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) →
    0 < Dv (some φ) → ∃ i : D.ι, D.Q i = (directionPoint R t x e φ).map
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
  zero : ∀ k : D.ι0, D.P0 k = directionPoint R t x e (zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) ∧
    Dv (zeroDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) = leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k)
  zero_surj : 0 < Dv (zeroDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) → Nonempty D.ι0
  inf : ∀ l : D.ιinf, D.Pinf l = infinityPoint R t x ∧ Dv none = rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inr l)
  inf_surj : 0 < Dv none → Nonempty D.ιinf

abbrev PrincipalLayer (e : A) (j : ℕ) :=
  LinearMap.ker (principalPowerReduction A e j).toLinearMap
abbrev PrincipalPowerQuotient (e : A) (j : ℕ) := A ⧸ (Ideal.span {e})^j

structure TwoChartCurveData where
  ι : Type
  [fin : Finite ι]
  Q : ι → Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x)
  [maximal : ∀ i, (Q i).IsMaximal]
  inj : Function.Injective Q
  onE : ∀ i, overlapException R t x ∈ Q i
  g : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i)
  transverse : ∀ i, LocallyTransverse (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i) (overlapException R t x) (g i)
  finite : ∀ i, FiniteContact (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i) (overlapException R t x) (g i)
  leftIso : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i) ≃+*
    CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) ((Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
        (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
  leftIso_compat : ∀ i (a : BlowupChart R t x), leftIso i
      (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i)
    (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) a)) =
    completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) ((Q i).comap (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x)
        (BlowupOverlap R t x))) a
  rightIso : ∀ i, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i) ≃+*
    CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) ((Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom)
  rightIso_compat : ∀ i (b : BlowupChart R x t), rightIso i
      (completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (Q i)
    (beta.right b)) = completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) ((Q i).comap beta.right.toRingHom) b
  ι0 : Type
  [fin0 : Finite ι0]
  P0 : ι0 → Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)
  [maximal0 : ∀ k, (P0 k).IsMaximal]
  inj0 : Function.Injective P0
  slope0 : ∀ k, chartSlope R t x ∈ P0 k
  onE0 : ∀ k, chartBase R t x t ∈ P0 k
  g0 : ∀ k, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (P0 k)
  transverse0 : ∀ k, LocallyTransverse (BlowupChart R t x) (P0 k) (chartBase R t x t) (g0 k)
  finite0 : ∀ k, FiniteContact (BlowupChart R t x) (P0 k) (chartBase R t x t) (g0 k)
  ιinf : Type
  [fininf : Finite ιinf]
  Pinf : ιinf → Ideal (BlowupChart R x t)
  [maximalinf : ∀ l, (Pinf l).IsMaximal]
  injinf : Function.Injective Pinf
  slopeinf : ∀ l, chartSlope R x t ∈ Pinf l
  onEinf : ∀ l, chartBase R x t x ∈ Pinf l
  ginf : ∀ l, CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (Pinf l)
  transverseinf : ∀ l, LocallyTransverse (BlowupChart R x t) (Pinf l) (chartBase R x t x) (ginf l)
  finiteinf : ∀ l, FiniteContact (BlowupChart R x t) (Pinf l) (chartBase R x t x) (ginf l)

theorem actual_cech_differentials_commute_with_reduction (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) (hnext : cechInputLattice R t x (j + 1) ≤
    (cechOutputLattice R t x (j + 1)).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d))
    (hnow : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤ (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap
    (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) :
    (cechOutputReduction R t x j).comp (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d (j+1) hnext) =
        (finiteCechDifferential R t x beta d j hnow).comp (cechInputReduction R t x j)

theorem actual_cech_preserves_exceptional_lattices (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ) :
    cechInputLattice R t x j ≤ (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)

theorem actual_cech_reductions_surjective (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (cechInputReduction R t x j) ∧ Function.Surjective
        (cechOutputReduction R t x j)
def blowupRelation (t x : R) : Polynomial R := Polynomial.C t * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x

theorem blowup_chart_relation (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    chartBase R t x t * chartSlope R t x = chartBase R t x x

theorem blowup_chart_ringHom_ext (R S : Type) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (t x : R)
    (f g : BlowupChart R t x →+* S) (hbase : ∀ r : R, f (chartBase R t x r) = g (chartBase R t x r))
    (hslope : f (chartSlope R t x) = g (chartSlope R t x)) :
    f = g

theorem blowup_chart_universal (R S : Type) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (t x : R) (phi : R →+* S)
    (z : S) (hz : phi t * z = phi x) :
    ∃ psi : BlowupChart R t x →+* S, (∀ a : R, psi (chartBase R t x a) = phi a) ∧ psi
        (chartSlope R t x) = z

theorem blowup_exceptional_parameter_regular (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : BlowupChart R t x => chartBase R t x t * a)

theorem boundary_chart_quotient_equiv (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ ρ : (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ Ideal.span {chartSlope R x t}) ≃+* (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t}),
        (∀ r : R, ρ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {chartSlope R x t}) (chartBase R x t r)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t}) r) ∧ ρ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {chartSlope R x t})
        (chartSlope R x t)) = 0

def cechInputReduction (j : ℕ) : CechLevelInput R t x (j+1) →ₗ[R] CechLevelInput R t x j :=
  (cechInputLattice R t x (j+1)).mapQ (cechInputLattice R t x j) LinearMap.id (by
    rintro z hz
    exact ⟨(Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j)) hz.1,
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j)) hz.2⟩)

def cechOutputReduction (j : ℕ) : CechLevelOutput R t x (j+1) →ₗ[R] CechLevelOutput R t x j :=
  (cechOutputLattice R t x (j+1)).mapQ (cechOutputLattice R t x j) LinearMap.id (by
    intro z hz
    exact (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ j)) hz)

def chartBase (t x : R) : R →+* BlowupChart R t x :=
  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R t x})).comp Polynomial.C

def chartExceptional (t x : R) : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) :=
  Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t}

def chartSlope (t x : R) : BlowupChart R t x :=
  Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {blowupRelation R t x}) Polynomial.X

def childIdealSet (s : State) (d : ℕ) (Q : divisorSupport Dv) :
    Set (Ideal (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)) :=
  {I | (∃ g, I = Ideal.span {g}) ∧
    Module.length (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)
      (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {divisorException R t x e Dv hinf Q})) =
        (Dv Q.val : ℕ∞) ∧
    (Q.val = none → Module.length (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)
      (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {divisorBoundary R t x e Dv hinf Q})) =
        ((stateContactT s - d : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) ∧
    (Q.val = zeroDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) → ∀ h : ℕ, stateContactX s = some h →
      Module.length (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)
        (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q ⧸ (I ⊔ Ideal.span {divisorBoundary R t x e Dv hinf Q}))
            =
          ((h - d : ℕ) : ℕ∞))}
def childOrder : Type := ∀ p : AllPoints D, localRing D p ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D p}

def childOrderMap : R →+* childOrder D :=
  RingHom.pi fun p => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {localCurve D p})).comp (localFromSurface D p)

theorem child_coordinate_map_scaled (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing R] [Algebra O R] (n : ℕ)
    (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R) (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hinj : Function.Injective (fun w : Fin n → O => pi • w)) :
    (∀ z : Fin n → O, pi • childCoordinateMap pi a b E H z = scaledStrictMap pi a b E H z) ∧
        Set.range (scaledStrictMap pi a b E H) = (fun w : Fin n → O => pi • w) '' Set.range
        (childCoordinateMap pi a b E H) ∧ ∀ T : Set (Fin n → O), scaledStrictMap pi a b E H ⁻¹'
        ((fun w : Fin n → O => pi • w) '' T) = childCoordinateMap pi a b E H ⁻¹' T

theorem coefficient_space_strict_instances (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) :
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Fin n → O)) = adicCylinderSpace (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O)
        ∧ MeasureTheory.Measure.IsAddHaarMeasure (coefficientMeasure O n) ∧
        MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (coefficientMeasure O n) ∧
        (∀ j, Finite (AdicQuotient (Ideal.span {pi}) (Fin n → O) j)) ∧ ∀ (a : ℕ)
        (L : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O)), Continuous (fun z : Fin n → O => (pi^a) • L z)

def commonKernel (j : ℕ) : Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) :=
  finiteSupportKernel (BlowupOverlap R t x) D.ι D.Q (commonLevelIdeal D j)

def commonLevelIdeal (j : ℕ) (i : D.ι) : Ideal (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i)) :=
  finiteLocalCurveIdeal (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i) (overlapException R t x) (D.g i) j

noncomputable def commonMultiplicity (i : D.ι) : ℕ :=
  (Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i))
    (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i) ⧸ commonLevelIdeal D 1 i)).toNat

def completedPointMap : A →+* CompletedLocalAt A P :=
  (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P)).comp (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))

theorem completed_point_power_contraction (A : Type) [CommRing A] (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal]
    (L : ℕ) (J : Ideal (CompletedLocalAt A P)) (hJ : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
    (Localization.AtPrime P)).map (localCompletionMap (Localization.AtPrime P))) ^ L ≤ J) :
    P^L ≤ J.comap (completedPointMap A P)

theorem concrete_surface_special_fiber_length_transport (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ) (a b : ℕ)
    (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (e : (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span
    {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) ≃+* SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a
    b) :
    Module.length (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b ⧸ Ideal.span
        {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi, f}) = Module.length
        (SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a b) (SpecialFiber (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O) a
        b ⧸ Ideal.span {e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span
        {algebraMap O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) pi}) f)})

def contractedLocalCurveIdeal (e : A) (g : CompletedLocalAt A P) (j : ℕ) : Ideal A :=
  (finiteLocalCurveIdeal A P e g j).comap (completedPointMap A P)

theorem contracted_ideal_map_localization_top (A S : Type) [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M S] (P I : Ideal A) (L : ℕ) (hPI : P ^ L ≤ I) (m : A)
    (hm : m ∈ M) (hmP : m ∈ P) :
    I.map (algebraMap A S) = ⊤

def coordinateCoset {n : ℕ} (pi : O) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : Fin n → O) : Set (Fin n → O) :=
  {z | adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) m z z₀}

def coordinateLinear {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → R) : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] O).smulRight (b i)
def coordinateScale {n : ℕ} (pi : O) (m : ℕ) (z : Fin n → O) : Fin n → O := (pi^m) • z

theorem coordinate_coset_representatives_exist (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O)
    (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n M : ℕ) :
    ∃ reps : Finset (Fin n → O), ∀ z : Fin n → O, ∃! z₀, z₀ ∈ reps ∧ adicCongr (Ideal.span {pi}) M z
        z₀

noncomputable def curveDataDegree : ℕ :=
  (∑ᶠ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftResidueDegree D s * leftMultiplicity D s) +
    ∑ᶠ l : D.ιinf, rightMultiplicity D (Sum.inr l)

def curveLimitMk : curveThreads R t x beta G →ₗ[R] CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G :=
  (curveNullThreads R t x beta G).mkQ

def curveNull : Submodule R (ℕ → ChartPair R t x) :=
  Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun j => curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j)

def curveNullThreads : Submodule R (curveThreads R t x beta G) :=
  (curveNull R t x beta G).comap (curveThreads R t x beta G).subtype
abbrev curveProduct : Type := ∀ p : AllPoints D, localQuotient D j p

def curveProductThreads : Type :=
  {u : ∀ j, curveProduct D j // ∀ j, curveProductReduction D j (u (j+1)) = u j}

def curveSections : Submodule R (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) :=
  ((overlapCurveIdeal R t x beta G j).restrictScalars R).comap (fullCechDifferential R t x beta 0)

def curveSectionsQuot : Submodule R ((BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t
    x beta G j) :=
  (curveSections R t x beta G j).map (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ

def curveThreads : Submodule R (ℕ → ChartPair R t x) :=
  Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun j => curveSections R t x beta G j) ⊓
    (Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun j => curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j)).comap
      (towerDelta R (fun _ => ChartPair R t x) (fun _ => LinearMap.id))

def directionPoint (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) :=
  (Ideal.span {φ.val}).comap (e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)))

instance directionPoint_isPrime (φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) :
    (directionPoint R t x e φ).IsPrime := by
  have : (Ideal.span {φ.val}).IsPrime :=
    (PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible φ.property.2).isPrime
  exact Ideal.IsPrime.comap _

def divisorBoundary : ∀ Q, divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q
  | ⟨none, _⟩ => @completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) _ (infinityPoint R t x) hinf
      (chartSlope R x t)
  | ⟨some φ, _⟩ => completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (directionPoint R t x e φ)
      (chartSlope R t x)

def divisorException : ∀ Q, divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q
  | ⟨none, _⟩ => @completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) _ (infinityPoint R t x) hinf
      (chartBase R x t x)
  | ⟨some φ, _⟩ => completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (directionPoint R t x e φ)
      (chartBase R t x t)

def divisorLocalRing : divisorSupport Dv → Type
  | ⟨none, _⟩ => @CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) _ (infinityPoint R t x) hinf
  | ⟨some φ, _⟩ => CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (directionPoint R t x e φ)

instance divisorLocalRing_commRing : ∀ Q, CommRing (divisorLocalRing R t x e Dv hinf Q)
  | ⟨none, _⟩ => inferInstanceAs (CommRing (@CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) _
      (infinityPoint R t x) hinf))
  | ⟨some φ, _⟩ => inferInstanceAs (CommRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x)
      (directionPoint R t x e φ)))

def exceptionalLevelIdeal (t x : R) (j : ℕ) : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) :=
  Ideal.span {(chartBase R t x t)^j}

def finiteCechDifferential (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ)
    (h : cechInputLattice R t x j ≤ (cechOutputLattice R t x j).comap
        (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d)) :
    CechLevelInput R t x j →ₗ[R] CechLevelOutput R t x j :=
  (cechInputLattice R t x j).mapQ (cechOutputLattice R t x j)
    (fullCechDifferential R t x beta d) h

def finiteSupportKernel : Ideal A :=
  ⨅ i, (J i).comap (completedPointMap A (P i))

def finiteSupportLevelKernel (e : A) (j : ℕ) : Ideal (A ⧸ (Ideal.span {e})^j) :=
  (finiteSupportKernel A ι P J).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {e})^j))

def finiteSupportQuotientMap : A →+* (∀ i, CompletedLocalAt A (P i) ⧸ J i) :=
  RingHom.pi fun i => (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J i)).comp (completedPointMap A (P i))

def fullCechDifferential (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) :
    (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) →ₗ[R] BlowupOverlap R t x :=
  ringCechDifferential (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))
    beta.right ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^d)
def infinityPoint : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t) := Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x, chartSlope R x t}

instance : AddCommGroup (CechInputThreads R t x) :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup (towerThreads R (fun j => CechLevelInput R t x j)
      (cechInputReduction R t x)))

instance : Module R (CechInputThreads R t x) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module R (towerThreads R (fun j => CechLevelInput R t x j)
      (cechInputReduction R t x)))

instance : AddCommGroup (CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G) :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup ((curveThreads R t x beta G) ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G))

instance : Module R (CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module R ((curveThreads R t x beta G) ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G))

instance (O : Type) [CommRing O] [Algebra O R] : Module O (CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module O ((curveThreads R t x beta G) ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G))

instance (O : Type) [CommRing O] [Algebra O R] : IsScalarTower O R (CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G) :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower O R ((curveThreads R t x beta G) ⧸ curveNullThreads R t x beta G))

instance : CommRing (childOrder D) := inferInstanceAs (CommRing
    (∀ p : AllPoints D, localRing D p ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D p}))

instance (O : Type) [CommRing O] [∀ p : AllPoints D, Algebra O (localRing D p)] : Algebra O
    (childOrder D) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Algebra O (∀ p : AllPoints D, localRing D p ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D p}))

def leftCurveIdeal : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) :=
  Ideal.span {G.left j} ⊔ (chartExceptional R t x)^j

def leftKernel (j : ℕ) : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x) :=
  finiteSupportKernel (BlowupChart R t x) (D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) (leftPoint D) (leftLevelIdeal D j)

noncomputable def leftMultiplicity (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) : ℕ :=
  (Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s))
    (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D s) ⧸ leftLevelIdeal D 1 s)).toNat

instance leftPoint_isPrime : ∀ s, (leftPoint D s).IsPrime
  | Sum.inl _ => Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  | Sum.inr k => Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (D.maximal0 k)

noncomputable def leftResidueDegree (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0) : ℕ :=
  (Module.length R (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ leftPoint D s)).toNat

def levelBase (t x : R) (j : ℕ) : R →+* ExceptionalChartLevel R t x j :=
  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x j)).comp (chartBase R t x)

def levelOverlapMap (t x : R) (j : ℕ) :
    ExceptionalChartLevel R t x j →+* ExceptionalOverlapLevel R t x j :=
  by exact @algebraMap (ExceptionalChartLevel R t x j) (ExceptionalOverlapLevel R t x j)
      inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance

def levelReduction (e g : S) (j : ℕ) : S ⧸ Ideal.span {g, e^(j+1)} →+* S ⧸ Ideal.span {g, e^j} :=
  Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro y (rfl | rfl)
    · exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · rw [pow_succ]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right e _ (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))))

def levelSlope (t x : R) (j : ℕ) : ExceptionalChartLevel R t x j :=
  Ideal.Quotient.mk (exceptionalLevelIdeal R t x j) (chartSlope R t x)

def localCompletionMap : A →+* LocalCompletion A :=
  by exact @algebraMap A (LocalCompletion A) inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance

def localCurve : ∀ p, localRing D p
  | Sum.inl i => D.g i
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) => leftData D (Sum.inr k)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) => rightData D (Sum.inr l)

def localException : ∀ p, localRing D p
  | Sum.inl i => completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i) (overlapException R t x)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) => completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))
      (chartBase R t x t)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) => completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))
      (chartBase R x t x)

def localFromSurface : ∀ p, R →+* localRing D p
  | Sum.inl i => ((completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i)).comp
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).comp (chartBase R t x)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) => (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))).comp
      (chartBase R t x)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) => (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))).comp
      (chartBase R x t)

abbrev localQuotient (p : AllPoints D) : Type :=
  localRing D p ⧸ Ideal.span {localCurve D p, localException D p ^ j}

def localRing : AllPoints D → Type
  | Sum.inl i => CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) => CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) => CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))

instance localRing_commRing : ∀ p, CommRing (localRing D p)
  | Sum.inl i => inferInstanceAs (CommRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i)))
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) => inferInstanceAs (CommRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R t x)
      (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))))
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) => inferInstanceAs (CommRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t)
      (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))))

def localSection : ∀ p, ChartPair R t x →+* localRing D p
  | Sum.inl i => ((completedPointMap (BlowupOverlap R t x) (D.Q i)).comp
      (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).comp (RingHom.fst _ _)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inl k) =>
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R t x) (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k))).comp (RingHom.fst _ _)
  | Sum.inr (Sum.inr l) =>
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l))).comp (RingHom.snd _ _)

def normalizationCorrection {n : ℕ} (pi : O) (a k : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R)
    (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R)
    (Q : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O)) (z : Fin n → O) : Fin n → O :=
  -(pi^(a-k)) • Q (normalizationQuadratic b E
    (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)))

def normalizationLinearPart {n : ℕ}
    (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R) :
    (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] (Fin n → O) :=
  (LinearMap.fst O (Fin n → O) R).comp (E.toLinearMap.comp H)

def overlapException : BlowupOverlap R t x :=
  algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t)

def overlapSlope : BlowupOverlap R t x :=
  algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartSlope R t x)

def residueRepresentative (c : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) : R :=
  Function.invFun (IsLocalRing.residue R) c

def rightCurveIdeal : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t) :=
  Ideal.span {G.right j} ⊔ (chartExceptional R x t)^j

def rightKernel (j : ℕ) : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t) :=
  finiteSupportKernel (BlowupChart R x t) (D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) (rightPoint D) (rightLevelIdeal D j)

noncomputable def rightMultiplicity (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) : ℕ :=
  (Module.length (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))
    (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s) ⧸ rightLevelIdeal D 1 s)).toNat

instance rightPoint_isPrime : ∀ s, (rightPoint D s).IsPrime
  | Sum.inl _ => Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  | Sum.inr l => Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (D.maximalinf l)

noncomputable def rightResidueDegree (s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) : ℕ :=
  (Module.length R (BlowupChart R x t ⧸ rightPoint D s)).toNat

def ringCechDifferential (left : U →ₐ[O] W) (right : V →ₐ[O] W) (transition : W) :
    (U × V) →ₗ[O] W where
  toFun z := left z.1 - transition * right z.2
  map_add' := by
    intro z w
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, map_add, mul_add]
    abel
  map_smul' := by
    intro c z
    simp [smul_sub]

def scaledStrictMap {n : ℕ} (pi : O) (a : ℕ) (b : Fin n → R)
    (E : R ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × R)) (H : (Fin n → O) →ₗ[O] R)
    (z : Fin n → O) : Fin n → O :=
  (pi^a) • (generatorNormalForm (pi^a) b E (H z)).1

def sectionsToProduct : ChartPair R t x →+* curveProduct D j :=
  RingHom.pi fun p => (Ideal.Quotient.mk _).comp (localSection D p)

def stateContactT : State → ℕ
  | .single _ c => c
  | .crossing _ _ c _ => c

def stateContactX : State → Option ℕ
  | .single _ _ => none
  | .crossing _ _ _ h => some h

def surfaceThreads : R →ₗ[R] CechInputThreads R t x :=
  LinearMap.codRestrict
    (towerThreads R (fun j => CechLevelInput R t x j) (cechInputReduction R t x))
    (LinearMap.pi fun j => surfaceToCechInput R t x j) (fun r => by
      rw [towerThreads, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      ext j
      change surfaceToCechInput R t x j r -
        cechInputReduction R t x j (surfaceToCechInput R t x (j+1) r) = 0
      rw [sub_eq_zero]
      rfl)

def surfaceToCechInput (j : ℕ) : R →ₗ[R] CechLevelInput R t x j :=
  (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ.comp (surfaceToChartPair R t x)

def surfaceToChartPair : R →ₗ[R] (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) :=
  LinearMap.prod (Algebra.linearMap R (BlowupChart R t x)) (Algebra.linearMap R (BlowupChart R x t))

def tangentLift (S : SurfaceData O R) (d : ℕ) (H : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) : R :=
  ∑ i : Fin (d+1), residueRepresentative R (H.coeff i.val) * S.t^(d-i.val) * S.x^i.val

theorem curve_ideal_lattice_eq_kernels (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R t x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R x t)] (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d)
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} =
    leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} =
    rightLevelKernel D j) (j : ℕ) :
    leftCurveIdeal R t x beta G j = leftKernel D j ∧ rightCurveIdeal R t x beta G j = rightKernel D
        j

theorem curve_ideal_lattice_le_sections (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (j : ℕ) :
    curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j ≤ curveSections R t x beta G j

theorem curve_lattices_antitone (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x)
    (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (j : ℕ) :
    curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1) ≤ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j ∧ curveSections R t x
        beta G (j+1) ≤ curveSections R t x beta G j

theorem curve_limit_level_map_exists (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ π : CurveOrderLimit R t x beta G →ₗ[R] curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j, ∀ p : curveThreads R
        t x beta G, ((π (curveLimitMk R t x beta G p) : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j) :
        (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j) =
        (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ (p.val j)

theorem curve_quotient_complete_equiv_threads (S : Type) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S] (e g : S)
    (he : e ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) :
    ∃ E : (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ≃ {u : ∀ j : ℕ, S ⧸ Ideal.span {g, e^j} // ∀ j, levelReduction e g j
        (u (j+1)) = u j}, ∀ s : S, ∀ j : ℕ, (E (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) s)).val j =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g, e^j}) s

theorem curve_sections_quot_reduction_exists (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d : ℕ) (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ ρ : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G (j+1) →ₗ[R] curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j, ∀ q :
        curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G (j+1), ∀ p : BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t,
        (q : (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1)) =
        (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G (j+1)).mkQ p → ((ρ q : curveSectionsQuot R t x beta G j) :
        (BlowupChart R t x × BlowupChart R x t) ⧸ curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j) =
        (curveIdealLattice R t x beta G j).mkQ p

theorem directionPoint_properties (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t x : R)
    [(Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)).IsMaximal] (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+*
    Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) (he : ∀ r : R, e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartBase R t x r)) = Polynomial.C
    (IsLocalRing.residue R r)) (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)
    (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X) :
    (∀ φ : AffineDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), (directionPoint R t x e φ).IsMaximal ∧
        chartBase R t x t ∈ directionPoint R t x e φ ∧ (chartSlope R t x ∈ directionPoint R t x e φ
        ↔ φ = zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) ∧
        ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x))).map e =
        Ideal.span {φ.val}) ∧ Function.Injective (directionPoint R t x e) ∧ directionPoint R t x e
        (zeroAffine (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)) = Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t, chartSlope R t x}

private theorem distinct_maximal_powers_coprime (A : Type) [CommRing A] (P Q : Ideal A)
    [P.IsMaximal]
    [Q.IsMaximal] (hPQ : P ≠ Q) (L M : ℕ) :
    IsCoprime (P^L) (Q^M)

theorem division_equiv_child_coordinates (O C : Type) [CommRing O] [CommRing C] [Algebra O C]
    (n : ℕ) (g : C) (bc : Fin n → C) (E : C ≃ₗ[O] ((Fin n → O) × C))
    (hE : ∀ w, E.symm w = divisionMap g bc w) :
    ∃ EC : (C ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ≃ₗ[O] (Fin n → O), ∀ w : C, EC
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) w) = (E w).1

theorem exceptional_chart_is_affine_line (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ e : ExceptionalChartLevel R t x 1 ≃+* Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}),
        (∀ r : R, e (levelBase R t x 1 r) = Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r)) ∧
        e (levelSlope R t x 1) = Polynomial.X

theorem exceptional_line_equiv_chart_exceptional (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)), (∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x)
        (chartBase R t x r)) = Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t,x} : Set R)) r)) ∧ e
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R t x) (chartSlope R t x)) = Polynomial.X

theorem exceptional_line_equiv_residue_field (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) :
    ∃ e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+* Polynomial
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R), (∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x)
        (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r)) ∧ e
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X

theorem exceptional_overlap_is_laurent_line (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) :
    ∃ e : ExceptionalOverlapLevel R t x 1 ≃+* LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}),
        (∀ r : R, e (levelOverlapMap R t x 1 (levelBase R t x 1 r)) = LaurentPolynomial.C
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r)) ∧ e (levelOverlapMap R t x 1 (levelSlope R t x 1))
        = LaurentPolynomial.T 1

private theorem finite_curve_exceptional_annihilator (C : Type) [CommRing C] (e g : C)
    (he : Function.Injective (fun a : C ⧸ Ideal.span {g} => Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) e *

def HasPattern (s : State) (D : ExceptionalDivisor k) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Prop :=
  exceptionalDegree k D = P.d.val ∧ D (infinityDirection k) = P.rt.val ∧
  (match s with
   | .single _ _ => True
   | .crossing _ _ _ _ => D (zeroDirection k) = P.rx.val) ∧
  ∀ ij : Fin s.degree × Fin s.degree,
    Nat.card {Q : ClosedDirection k // Q ∉ boundaryDirections k s ∧
      directionDegree k Q = ij.1.val + 1 ∧ D Q = ij.2.val + 1} = (P.other ij).val

theorem count_normalizedFactors_divisorAffinePolynomial (k : Type) [Field k]
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) (lc : k) (hlc : lc ≠ 0) (φ : AffineDirection k) :
    Multiset.count φ.val (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
        (Polynomial.C lc * divisorAffinePolynomial k Dv)) = Dv (some φ) ∧
        (φ.val ∣ divisorAffinePolynomial k Dv ↔ 0 < Dv (some φ))

def directionDegree : ClosedDirection k → ℕ
  | none => 1
  | some phi => phi.val.natDegree

def divisorAffinePolynomial (D : ExceptionalDivisor k) : Polynomial k :=
  D.prod fun P r => match P with | none => 1 | some phi => phi.val ^ r
def divisorSupport (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) : Type := {Q : ClosedDirection k // 0 < Dv Q}

instance divisorSupport_finite (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor k) : Finite (divisorSupport Dv) :=
  Finite.of_injective (fun Q : divisorSupport Dv =>
      (⟨Q.val, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp Q.property)⟩ : Dv.support))
    (fun _ _ h => by
      have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
      exact Subtype.ext h')

def exceptionalDegree (D : ExceptionalDivisor k) : ℕ :=
  D.sum fun P r => directionDegree k P * r

abbrev patternDivisors (s : State) (P : TangentPattern s.degree) : Type :=
  {D : ExceptionalDivisor k // HasPattern k s D P}

def zeroAffine (k : Type) [Field k] : AffineDirection k :=
  ⟨Polynomial.X, Polynomial.monic_X, Polynomial.irreducible_X⟩

def zeroDirection : ClosedDirection k :=
  some ⟨Polynomial.X, Polynomial.monic_X, Polynomial.irreducible_X⟩

        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).IsMaximal ∧
      ((directionPoint R t x e φ).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))).comap
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) = directionPoint R t x e φ)
    (hinfmax : (infinityPoint R t x).IsMaximal ∧ chartBase R x t x ∈ infinityPoint R t x ∧
      chartSlope R x t ∈ infinityPoint R t x)
    (htrL : ∀ (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R t x)) [P.IsMaximal], chartBase R t x t ∈ P →
      TransverseFiniteAt (BlowupChart R t x) P (chartBase R t x t))
    (htrR : ∀ (P : Ideal (BlowupChart R x t)) [P.IsMaximal], chartBase R x t x ∈ P →
      chartSlope R x t ∈ P → TransverseFiniteAt (BlowupChart R x t) P (chartBase R x t x)) :
    ∃ D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta, MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧ ∀ f : R,
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, strictTransformAt R t x (leftPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
          Ideal.span {leftData D s}) →
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf, strictTransformAt R x t (rightPoint D s) d (Ideal.span {f}) =
          Ideal.span {rightData D s}) →
      ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, divisorStrictTransform R t x e Dv hinf
          d (Ideal.span {f}) Q = I Q

private noncomputable def commonPoint (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t x : R)
    (e : (BlowupChart R t x ⧸ chartExceptional R t x) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))

    Ideal (BlowupOverlap R t x) :=
  (directionPoint R t x e i.1).map (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x))

private noncomputable def completedLocalCast {A : Type} [CommRing A] {P' P : Ideal A} [P'.IsPrime]
    [P.IsPrime] (h : P' = P) :
    CompletedLocalAt A P' ≃+* CompletedLocalAt A P := by

theorem fixed_tangent_cell_curve_datum (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (u : (TwoSeries O)ˣ)
    (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) [IsDomain (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)]
        [IsRegularLocalRing (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)] (S : SurfaceData O
            (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hS : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b ∧ S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b) (e :
        (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+* Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
            (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)))
    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)
        (tBase O pi u a b r)) = Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b) (tSlope O pi u a b)) = Polynomial.X)
    (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) (s : State)
        (d : ℕ) (J : Ideal (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
    (hJ : J ∈ fixedTangentCell O (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) S s d Dv)
        (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (surfaceX O pi u a b)) :
    ∃ (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (c : Fin (d+1) → ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
        (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (surfaceX O pi u a b) beta), J = Ideal.span {f} ∧
      f = ∑ i : Fin (d+1), c i * surfaceT O pi u a b^(d - i.val) * surfaceX O pi u a b^i.val ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        leftData D s = completedPointMap (tChart O pi u a b) (leftPoint D s)
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (tChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            tSlope O pi u a b^i.val) ∈ leftPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        Ideal.span {rightData D s} = Ideal.span {completedPointMap (xChart O pi u a b)
            (rightPoint D s)
          (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
              xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val))} ∧
        (∑ i : Fin (d+1), algebraMap (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (xChart O pi u a b) (c i) *
            xSlope O pi u a b^(d - i.val)) ∈ rightPoint D s) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
            (leftPoint D s) d J = Ideal.span {leftData D s}) ∧
      (∀ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf,
        strictTransformAt (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
            (rightPoint D s) d J = Ideal.span {rightData D s}) ∧
      MatchesDivisor e D Dv ∧
      curveDataDegree D = exceptionalDegree (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))
          Dv

    (hS : S.t = surfaceT O pi u a b ∧ S.x = surfaceX O pi u a b ∧ S.a = a ∧ S.b = b)
    (e : (tChart O pi u a b ⧸ tExc O pi u a b) ≃+*

    (he : ∀ r : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (tExc O pi u a b)

      (surfaceX O pi u a b)).IsPrime) (s : State) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hs : (∃ c : ℕ, s = State.single a c ∧ b = 0) ∨ (∃ c h : ℕ, s = State.crossing a b c h ∧ 0 < b))
    (hdc : d ≤ stateContactT s) (hdh : ∀ h : ℕ, stateContactX s = some h → d ≤ h)
    (hDinf : 0 < Dv none ↔ d < stateContactT s)
    (hDzero : ∀ h : ℕ, stateContactX s = some h →
      (0 < Dv (zeroDirection (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b))) ↔ d < h))
    (beta : BlowupRestriction (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)
      (surfaceX O pi u a b))
    (D : TwoChartCurveData (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      beta)
    (hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv) (hdD : curveDataDegree D = d) (f : ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)
    (G : GluedGenerators (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b)
      beta d)
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b) (surfaceT O pi u a b)

      (surfaceT O pi u a b) (surfaceX O pi u a b) e Dv hinf Q))
    (hI : ∀ Q : divisorSupport Dv, I Q ∈ childIdealSet (ConcreteSurface O pi u a b)

private theorem glued_level_one_data (O R : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra O R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (S : SurfaceData O R) (beta : BlowupRestriction R S.t S.x)
    (D : TwoChartCurveData R S.t S.x beta) (Dv : ExceptionalDivisor (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (e : (BlowupChart R S.t S.x ⧸ chartExceptional R S.t S.x) ≃+*
      Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartBase R S.t S.x r)) =
      Polynomial.C (IsLocalRing.residue R r))
    (heZ : e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (chartExceptional R S.t S.x) (chartSlope R S.t S.x)) = Polynomial.X)
    (hm : MatchesDivisor e D Dv) [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.t S.x)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (BlowupChart R S.x S.t)] (hreg : RegularParameterPair R S.t S.x)
    (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R S.x S.t) (f : R)
    (G : GluedGenerators R S.t S.x beta (curveDataDegree D))
    (hf : ∀ j : ℕ, surfaceToCechInput R S.t S.x j f =
      (cechInputLattice R S.t S.x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R S.t S.x G j))
    (hG : ∀ j : ℕ,
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R S.t S.x)^j) (G.left j)} =
        leftLevelKernel D j ∧
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((chartExceptional R S.x S.t)^j) (G.right j)} =
        rightLevelKernel D j) :
    ∃ (c : Fin (curveDataDegree D+1) → R) (a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
      f = ∑ i : Fin (curveDataDegree D+1), c i * S.t^(curveDataDegree D - i.val) * S.x^i.val ∧

        curveDataDegree D ∧
      ∀ i : Fin (curveDataDegree D+1),
        (divisorAffinePolynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) Dv * Polynomial.C a).coeff i.val =

private theorem isUnit_coeffs_of_residue_eq {R : Type} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]

private theorem two_chart_level_one_coefficients_left (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (D : TwoChartCurveData R t x beta)

    (FA : BlowupChart R t x) (hFA : leftLevelKernel D 1 =
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk ((Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^1) FA}) :
    ∃ (m r : ℕ) (cA : Fin (m+1) → R), FA - ∑ i : Fin (m+1), algebraMap R (BlowupChart R t x) (cA i)
        * (chartSlope R t x)^i.val ∈ chartExceptional R t x ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val < r → cA i ∈ Ideal.span {t,x}) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (m+1), i.val = r → cA i ∉ Ideal.span {t,x}) ∧ r ≤ m ∧ r = ∑ᶠ k : D.ι0,
        leftMultiplicity D (Sum.inr k) ∧ m = ∑ᶠ s : D.ι ⊕ D.ι0, leftResidueDegree D s *
        leftMultiplicity D s

private theorem cech_layer_coordinates (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (d j : ℕ)
    (a : BlowupChart R t x) (b : BlowupChart R x t)
    (ha : a ∈ (Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t}) ^ j) (hb : b ∈ (Ideal.span {chartBase R x t x}) ^ j)
    (hD : fullCechDifferential R t x beta d (a, b) ∈
      (Ideal.span {algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) (chartBase R t x t)}) ^
        (j + 1))
          :
    ∃ LA : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R]
        PrincipalLayer (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j,
    ∃ LB : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R]
        PrincipalLayer (BlowupChart R x t) (chartBase R x t x) j,
    (∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,
        (LA (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)).val
      = principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j
          (chartBase R t x r * (chartSlope R t x)^i)) ∧
    (∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,
        (LB (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)).val
      = principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R x t) (chartBase R x t x) j
          (chartBase R x t r * (chartSlope R x t)^i)) ∧
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}),
      (LA P).val = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a ∧ (LB Q).val = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b ∧
      P.toLaurent - LaurentPolynomial.T ((j:ℤ) - d) * LaurentPolynomial.invert Q.toLaurent = 0

private theorem cech_layer_coordinates_left (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (j : ℕ)
    (LA : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R]
      PrincipalLayer (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j)
    (hLA : ∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,
      (LA (Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) * Polynomial.X^i)).val =
        principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R t x) (chartBase R t x t) j
          (chartBase R t x r * (chartSlope R t x)^i))
    (LO : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer (BlowupOverlap R t x)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)) j)
    (hLO : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (LO (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)) j
        ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x r) *
          selfZPow (chartSlope R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x) ell))
    (hψ : (Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^(j+1) ≤ ((Ideal.span
      {(algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1)).comap
        (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)))
    (P : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x})) :
    Ideal.quotientMap _ (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) hψ (LA P).val =

    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (d j : ℕ)
    (LB : Polynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R]

    (hLB : ∀ r : R, ∀ i : ℕ,

        principalLayerMap (BlowupChart R x t) (chartBase R x t x) j
          (chartBase R x t r * (chartSlope R x t)^i))
    (LO : LaurentPolynomial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t,x}) ≃ₗ[R] PrincipalLayer (BlowupOverlap R t x)
      ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)) j)
    (hLO : ∀ r : R, ∀ ell : ℤ, (LO (LaurentPolynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t,x}) r) *
      LaurentPolynomial.T ell)).val = principalLayerMap (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)) j
        ((algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x r) *

      {(algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)) (chartBase R t x t)})^(j+1)).comap

        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (chartSlope R t x))^d) =
      (LO (LaurentPolynomial.T ((j:ℤ) - d) * LaurentPolynomial.invert Q.toLaurent)).val

private theorem cech_layer_step (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)
    (hreg : RegularParameterPair R t x)
    (beta : BlowupRestriction R t x) (hregSwap : RegularParameterPair R x t) (d j : ℕ)

    (hD : fullCechDifferential R t x beta d (a, b) ∈

        (j + 1))

    ∃ r ∈ (Ideal.span {t,x})^(j - d),
      a - (chartBase R t x t)^d * chartBase R t x r ∈ (Ideal.span {chartBase R t x t})^(j+1) ∧

      commonLevelIdeal D j i

private theorem sectionsToProduct_eq_zero_iff (p : ChartPair R t x) :
    sectionsToProduct D j p = 0 ↔
      (∀ i, completedPointMap _ (D.Q i) (algebraMap (BlowupChart R t x) (BlowupOverlap R t x)
        p.1) ∈ commonLevelIdeal D j i) ∧
      (∀ k, completedPointMap _ (leftPoint D (Sum.inr k)) p.1 ∈ leftLevelIdeal D j (Sum.inr k)) ∧
      ∀ l, completedPointMap _ (rightPoint D (Sum.inr l)) p.2 ∈

private theorem strict_transform_right_point_equation (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) [(Ideal.span

    (G : GluedGenerators R t x beta d) (hG : ∀ j : ℕ, Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((chartExceptional R t x)^j) (G.left j)} = leftLevelKernel D j ∧ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk
    ((chartExceptional R x t)^j) (G.right j)} = rightLevelKernel D j) (f : R) (hf : ∀ j : ℕ,
    surfaceToCechInput R t x j f = (cechInputLattice R t x j).mkQ (gluedFunctionPair R t x G j)) (s
    : D.ι ⊕ D.ιinf) [IsNoetherianRing (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))]
    (hereg : Function.Injective (fun a : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) =>
    (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x) * a)) (hgreg :

    {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)} =>
    Ideal.Quotient.mk
    (Ideal.span {(completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (chartBase R x t x)})
    (rightData D s) * a)) :
    ∃ v : (CompletedLocalAt (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s))ˣ,
      (completedPointMap (BlowupChart R x t) (rightPoint D s)) (algebraMap R (BlowupChart R x t) f)

theorem two_chart_kernels_agree_on_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R)

theorem two_chart_level_generators_agree_on_overlap (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t x : R) (beta :

SurfaceBlowup/Cluster/Defs.lean::Surface.statement: def clusterCell (n : ℕ) : Set (Fin n → O) := {a | ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O}

noncomputable def clusterDensity (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
    coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)
noncomputable def clusterExpr (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) : Expr := lawCoeff (rootLaw n) σ

private theorem clusterCell_eq_image (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) :
    clusterCell O n = (fun z : Fin n → O => pi • z) '' Set.univ

private theorem clusterCell_inter_eq_image (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] (pi : O) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterCell O n ∩ {a | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O a) σ} =
      (fun z : Fin n → O => pi • z) ''
        {z | HasPolynomialTypeF O (monicPolynomial O (pi • z)) σ}

theorem clusterDensity_eq_etale (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing O] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)] [TopologicalSpace O] [IsTopologicalRing O]
    [CompactSpace O] [T2Space O] [SecondCountableTopology O] [MeasurableSpace O] [BorelSpace O]
    (htop : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O)) (n : ℕ) (σ : FactorType) :
    clusterDensity O n σ =
      coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n ∩
        {a | (monicPolynomial O a).Separable ∧ HasPolynomialType O (monicPolynomial O a) σ}) /
        coefficientMeasure O n (clusterCell O n)

private noncomputable def lowOrderIdeal (k : Type) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) : Ideal (TwoSeries k) where
  carrier := {φ | ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, m 0 + m 1 < n → MvPowerSeries.coeff m φ = 0}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' ha hb m hm := by simp [ha m hm, hb m hm]
  smul_mem' c x hx m hm := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have h0 := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 0) hp
    have h1 := congrArg (fun f ↦ f 1) hp
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
    rw [hx p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]

private theorem coeff_m4ContactThree (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt 2 (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4ContactThree)) σ =
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(3,1)} then 20/31 else 0) + (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,3)} then 1/31 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(2,1)} then 26/93 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,2)} then 7/186 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,1)} then 1/186 else 0)

private theorem coeff_m4Contact_at_two (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt 2 (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4Contact)) σ = coeffAt 2 (stateLaw (.single 1 4)) σ

private theorem coeff_m4Cubic (q : ℚ) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4Cubic)) σ = if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,3)} then 1 else 0

private theorem coeff_m4Inert (q : ℚ) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4Inert)) σ = if σ = {(1,4)} then 1 else 0

private theorem coeff_m4QuadraticContact (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt 2 (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4QuadraticContact)) σ =
      (if σ = {(2,2)} then 4/5 else 0) + (if σ = (1,2) ::ₘ {(1,2)} then 1/10 else 0) +
        (if σ = {(1,4)} then 1/10 else 0)

private theorem coeff_m4SplitTangent (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt 2 (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4SplitTangent)) σ =
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(2,1)} then 2/3 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,1)} then 1/6 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,2)} then 1/6 else 0)

private theorem coeff_m4TangentQuadratic (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt 2 (childProd (otherChildren 1 m4TangentQuadratic)) σ =
      (if σ = (1,2) ::ₘ {(2,1)} then 2/3 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,2) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,1)} then 1/6 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,2) ::ₘ {(1,2)} then 1/6 else 0)

private theorem coeff_mul_lawOne (q : ℚ) (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (lawMul L lawOne) σ = coeffAt q L σ
private theorem coeff_nil (q : ℚ) (σ : FactorType) : coeffAt q [] σ = 0

private theorem coeff_prod_perm {Ls Ls' : List Law} (hperm : Ls.Perm Ls') (q : ℚ)
    (σ : FactorType) : coeffAt q (lawProd Ls) σ = coeffAt q (lawProd Ls') σ

private theorem coeff_prod_singleton (q : ℚ) (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (lawProd [L]) σ = coeffAt q L σ

private theorem coeff_scale (q : ℚ) (x : Expr) (L : Law) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (lawScale x L) σ = x.eval q * coeffAt q L σ

private theorem crossing_two_two_law (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (stateLaw (.crossing 1 1 2 2)) σ = (if σ = {(4,1)} then 1/(q+1) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,2)} then (q^2+q+1)/(2*q*(q+1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(2,1),(2,1)} then (q^2-q-1)/(2*q*(q+1)) else 0)

private theorem crossing_unique_pattern (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hh : 0 < h) (q : ℚ) (hone : c = 1 ∨ h = 1) (hnot : ¬ (c = 1 ∧ h = 1)) :
    ∃ P : TangentPattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree,
      allowedPatterns (State.crossing a b c h) = {P} ∧
      children (State.crossing a b c h) P =
        (if 1 < c then [(1, .crossing (a+b) a 1 (c-1))] else []) ++
        (if 1 < h then [(1, .crossing (a+b) b 1 (h-1))] else []) ∧
      ((tangentCount (State.crossing a b c h) P).mul
        (divisorProbability (State.crossing a b c h) P.d.val)).eval q = 1
private theorem degree_pos (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) : 0 < s.degree

private theorem densityValue_eq {x : Expr} {q : ℕ} {r : ℚ} (h : x.eval q = r) :

private theorem divisorCount_eval {n : ℕ} (q : ℚ) (off : ℤ) (m : Pattern n) :
    (divisorCount off m).eval q = ∏ i : Fin n,
      (falling (availablePoints off (i.val+1)) (∑ j, (m (i, j)).val)).eval q *
        (1 / ∏ j, ((m (i, j)).val.factorial : ℚ))

private theorem divisorCount_m3 (q : ℚ) :
    (divisorCount 0 m3Inert).eval q = (q^3 - q) / 3 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m3Quadratic).eval q = q * ((q^2 - q) / 2) ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m3Tangent).eval q = q * (q - 1) ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m3Split).eval q = q * (q - 1) * (q - 2) / 6 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m3Contact).eval q = q

private theorem divisorCount_m4_at_two :
    (divisorCount 0 m4Split).eval 2 = 0 ∧ (divisorCount 0 m4SplitTangent).eval 2 = 0 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m4SplitQuadratic).eval 2 = 1 ∧ (divisorCount 0 m4ContactThree).eval 2 = 2 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m4Cubic).eval 2 = 4 ∧ (divisorCount 0 m4TwoTangent).eval 2 = 1 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m4TangentQuadratic).eval 2 = 2 ∧ (divisorCount 0 m4TwoQuadratic).eval 2 = 0 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m4QuadraticContact).eval 2 = 1 ∧ (divisorCount 0 m4Inert).eval 2 = 3 ∧
    (divisorCount 0 m4Contact).eval 2 = 2

private theorem divisorCount_m4_projective_at_two :
    (divisorCount 1 m4Split).eval 2 = 0 ∧ (divisorCount 1 m4SplitTangent).eval 2 = 3 ∧
    (divisorCount 1 m4SplitQuadratic).eval 2 = 3 ∧ (divisorCount 1 m4ContactThree).eval 2 = 6 ∧
    (divisorCount 1 m4Cubic).eval 2 = 6 ∧ (divisorCount 1 m4TwoTangent).eval 2 = 3 ∧
    (divisorCount 1 m4TangentQuadratic).eval 2 = 3 ∧ (divisorCount 1 m4TwoQuadratic).eval 2 = 0 ∧
    (divisorCount 1 m4QuadraticContact).eval 2 = 1 ∧ (divisorCount 1 m4Inert).eval 2 = 3 ∧
    (divisorCount 1 m4Contact).eval 2 = 3

private theorem divisorCount_spat {n : ℕ} (q : ℚ) (off : ℤ) (ij₀ : Fin n × Fin n)
    (v : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (divisorCount off (spat ij₀ v)).eval q =
      (falling (availablePoints off (ij₀.1.val+1)) v).eval q / ((v : ℕ).factorial : ℚ)

private theorem divisorCount_zero {n : ℕ} (q : ℚ) (off : ℤ) :
    (divisorCount off fun _ : Fin n × Fin n ↦ (0 : Fin (n+1))).eval q = 1

private theorem eq_spat {n : ℕ} (m : Pattern n) (ij₀ : Fin n × Fin n) (v : Fin (n + 1))

private theorem eval_pow (q : ℚ) (x : Expr) (n : ℕ) : (x.pow n).eval q = x.eval q ^ n

private theorem eval_prod (q : ℚ) (xs : List Expr) :
    (Expr.prod xs).eval q = (xs.map (Expr.eval q)).prod
private theorem eval_subst (q : ℚ) (x y : Expr) : (x.subst y).eval q = x.eval (y.eval q)

private theorem eval_sum (q : ℚ) (xs : List Expr) :
    (Expr.sum xs).eval q = (xs.map (Expr.eval q)).sum

private noncomputable def exitLaw (s : State) : Law :=
  (allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
    if SelfPattern s P then [] else
      lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))

private noncomputable def exitLawFuel (k : ℕ) (s : State) : Law :=
  (allowedPatterns s).toList.flatMap fun P ↦
    if SelfPattern s P then [] else
      lawScale (.mul (tangentCount s P) (divisorProbability s P.d.val))
        (lawProd ((children s P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLawFuel k z.2)))

private theorem exitLawFuel_congr (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (k₁ k₂ : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℕ × State, z.2.Valid → z.2.rank < s.rank →
      stateLawFuel k₁ z.2 = stateLawFuel k₂ z.2) :
    exitLawFuel k₁ s = exitLawFuel k₂ s
private theorem exitLawFuel_rank (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) : exitLawFuel s.rank s = exitLaw s
private def indicator (σ K : FactorType) : ℚ := if σ = K then 1 else 0

private theorem ite_add_zero (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (a b : ℚ) :
    (if c then a + b else 0) = (if c then a else 0) + (if c then b else 0)

private theorem ite_eq_mul_indicator (σ K : FactorType) (c : ℚ) [Decidable (σ = K)] :
    (if σ = K then c else 0) = c * indicator σ K

private theorem ite_le_sub (t σ u : FactorType) (c d : ℚ) :
    (if t ≤ σ then c * (if σ - t = u then d else 0) else 0) = if σ = t + u then c * d else 0

private theorem ite_le_sub_one (t σ u : FactorType) (d : ℚ) :
    (if t ≤ σ then (if σ - t = u then d else 0) else 0) = if σ = t + u then d else 0

private theorem ite_mem_erase (p : ℕ × ℕ) (σ t : FactorType) (x : ℚ) :
    (if p ∈ σ then (if σ.erase p = t then x else 0) else 0) = if σ = p ::ₘ t then x else 0
private theorem lawDescend_lawAtom (δ a : ℕ) : lawDescend δ (lawAtom a 1) = lawAtom a δ

private theorem lawProd_cons (L : Law) (Ls : List Law) :
    lawProd (L :: Ls) = lawMul L (lawProd Ls)
private theorem lawProd_nil : lawProd [] = lawOne
private abbrev m3Contact : Pattern 3 := fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 2 then 1 else 0

private theorem pattern_eq_of_weight_two {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (m : Pattern n)
    (h : patternWeight m = 2) :
    m = spat (⟨0, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn⟩, ⟨0, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn⟩)
        ⟨2, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn⟩ ∨
    m = spat (⟨0, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn⟩, ⟨1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hn⟩)
        ⟨1, Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn)⟩ ∨
    m = spat (⟨1, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.one_lt_two hn⟩, ⟨0, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn⟩)
        ⟨1, Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.two_pos hn)⟩

private theorem scaleType_injective {δ : ℕ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : Function.Injective (scaleType δ)

private theorem selfPattern_single_iff {a c : ℕ} (P : TangentPattern (State.single a c).degree) :
    SelfPattern (.single a c) P ↔
      ((if P.rt.val = 0 then [] else [(1, State.crossing a a P.rt.val (c - P.d.val))]) ++

private noncomputable def shiftedCoeff (q : ℚ) (M : Law) (τ σ : FactorType) : ℚ :=

private theorem shiftedCoeff_prod_perm (q : ℚ) {Ls Ls' : List Law} (hperm : Ls.Perm Ls') :

private theorem single_three_law_at_two (σ : FactorType) : coeffAt 2 (stateLaw (.single 1 3)) σ =

      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(2,1)} then 26/93 else 0) + (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,2)} then 7/186 else 0) +
      (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,1)} then 1/186 else 0)

theorem single_two_law (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (q : ℚ) (hq : 1 < q) (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt q (stateLaw (.single a 2)) σ = (if σ = {(2*a,1)} then q/(q+1) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(a,1),(a,1)} then 1/(2*(q+1)) else 0) +
      (if σ = {(a,2)} then 1/(2*(q+1)) else 0)

private theorem single_two_law_at_four (σ : FactorType) :
    coeffAt (2^2) (stateLaw (.single 1 2)) σ =
      (if σ = {(2,1)} then 4/5 else 0) + (if σ = (1,1) ::ₘ {(1,1)} then 1/10 else 0) +
        (if σ = {(1,2)} then 1/10 else 0)

private def spat {n : ℕ} (ij₀ : Fin n × Fin n) (v : Fin (n + 1)) : Pattern n :=

private theorem spat_val {n : ℕ} (ij₀ : Fin n × Fin n) (v : Fin (n + 1)) (ij : Fin n × Fin n) :

noncomputable def stateLawFuelStep (k : ℕ) (s : State) : Law :=

private theorem stateLawFuel_eq (k : ℕ) (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) (hk : s.rank < k) :

private theorem stateLawFuel_succ (k : ℕ) (s : State) (hnt : s.terminal = false) :

private theorem stateLaw_terminal (a : ℕ) : stateLaw (.single a 1) = lawAtom a 1

private theorem sum_allowed_single_one_four (f : TangentPattern (State.single 1 4).degree → ℚ) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns (.single 1 4), (if SelfPattern (.single 1 4) P then 0 else f P) =
      f ⟨1, 1, 0, fun _ ↦ 0⟩ + f ⟨2, 2, 0, fun _ ↦ 0⟩ +
        f ⟨2, 1, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 0 then 1 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 3, 0, fun _ ↦ 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 2, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 0 then 1 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 1, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 0 then 2 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 1, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 1 then 1 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 1, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 1 ∧ ij.2.val = 0 then 1 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4Split⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4SplitTangent⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4SplitQuadratic⟩ +
        f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4ContactThree⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4Cubic⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4TwoTangent⟩ +
        f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4TangentQuadratic⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4TwoQuadratic⟩ +
        f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4QuadraticContact⟩ + f ⟨4, 0, 0, m4Inert⟩

private theorem sum_allowed_single_one_three (f : TangentPattern (State.single 1 3).degree → ℚ) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns (.single 1 3), (if SelfPattern (.single 1 3) P then 0 else f P) =
      f ⟨1, 1, 0, fun _ ↦ 0⟩ + f ⟨2, 2, 0, fun _ ↦ 0⟩ +
        f ⟨2, 1, 0, fun ij ↦ if ij.1.val = 0 ∧ ij.2.val = 0 then 1 else 0⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 0, 0, m3Inert⟩ + f ⟨3, 0, 0, m3Quadratic⟩ + f ⟨3, 0, 0, m3Tangent⟩ +
        f ⟨3, 0, 0, m3Split⟩
private theorem tag_le_one (s : State) : s.tag ≤ 1

private theorem tangentCount_single_one_four (m : Pattern 4) :
    tangentCount (.single 1 4) ⟨4, 0, 0, m⟩ = divisorCount (n := 4) 0 m

private theorem tangentCount_single_one_three (m : Pattern 3) :
    tangentCount (.single 1 3) ⟨3, 0, 0, m⟩ = divisorCount (n := 3) 0 m

private theorem univ_toList_perm (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).toList.Perm (List.finRange n ×ˢ List.finRange n)
private theorem weight_le_degree (s : State) (hs : s.Valid) : s.weight ≤ s.degree
